name: @armature/mcp
description: An MCP server that lets an AI assistant ask an Armature hub about a design, through its intelligence reads at a named commit

scripts.build:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/armature-mcp.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
